continuous_baseline: Unmodified backup InEKF class imported by file, same sensor-only t0+.6 initial X and physical covariance as UTIL replay; native original noise TDoA variance .13, other native defaults preserved.
conditional_baseline: Optional diagnostic: unmodified author class begins at the normal-shadow terminal state, covariance and bias, not an original continuous algorithm.
conditional_source_policy: retain_normal, including its common radio-only p/v reset; this is separately labeled conditional, never called original continuous
native_queue_primary: Raw native IMU (~1000Hz), gyro interpolated onto acc timestamps, original main event query and dt. Original author and current recursive kernel receive identical calls and .13 TDoA variance. Current retain/full/evidence/bank candidates are recomputed from native-prefix/shadow states; their fixed batch window integration remains 100Hz.
native_original_prior_primary: Primary external conclusion uses original main P numerically, with the same sensor-only X, bias, calls, noise and scoring. Current policies pull that original invariant P back through the common initial X into physical coordinates, so their initial invariant P exactly equals the author's. That physical P is also their common handoff reset. Wide common-prior runs remain a separately labeled initialization sensitivity, not causal proof about native bias indexing.
native_original_main_positive_reference: Separately labeled original_truth: literal original-main position/orientation from Vicon, original P, zero bias, .13 variance, and unconditional original TDOA2 ring selection. This is a health check, not a sensor-only result or a reproduction of the paper's full-run aggregate.
truth_usage: No truth initialization, tuning, alignment, or case selection. Truth scoring starts only after requested sensor-only trajectories are generated.
wrapper: 100Hz average adjacent IMU samples; process all pending native packets at the next IMU timestamp, matching UTIL call times. Exclude initial radio already consumed by .6s CV fit. No X_hat synchronization between native author corrections. Convert input gyro-first bias into author's acceleration-first predict order, preserving its later native updates and internal inconsistency.
primary: Unaligned surveyed-world XY RMSE on common 20Hz post-handoff grid; Z, wrapped physical yaw, SO3, whole trajectory, rejection and numerical failures separately retained.
selection: All 16 named recordings fixed before scoring. No result-dependent deletion, replacement or parameter adjustment.
